findings.reason: OPEN: F0003:S1:T3 supplies reported half-lives, but does not state individual versus group-summary derivation, animal counts, uncertainty definitions, half-life phase or estimation window. These parameters cannot establish individual animal trajectories.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed parameter definitions, sampling and aggregation information, counts and any reported uncertainty; preserve unspecified fields as NOT_FOUND pending review.

findings.reason: OPEN: F0003:S1:T3:A37 explicitly leaves salt/hydrate basis unstated. Unchanged-drug specificity, total versus unbound basis and animal health/infection state are NOT_FOUND. The meropenem dosing statement does not establish the comparator dose or regimen.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed analyte, concentration-basis, formulation and health-state definitions for retained records; retain comparator administration as unknown unless separately supported.

findings.reason: OPEN: Reported half-lives and meropenem 20 mg/kg single IV bolus are available, but concentration-time observations, sampling times and time origin, experimental-unit identifiers, sample counts, variability and censoring metadata were not located on this page. This is a page-level input gap, not evidence that the study lacks these materials.
findings.needed_material: Permitted linked concentration-time records and their sampling, assay, grouping and dosing metadata; assess model-input sufficiency downstream without treating these half-lives as observations.

findings.reason: OPEN DEFERRED: Mouse, rat and guinea pig reported half-lives provide parameter evidence only. This page does not establish component eligibility, identifiability or held-out prediction support, and supplies no pulmonary or CSF measurements.
findings.needed_material: Animal PK assessment of linked permitted evidence, documenting eligibility, exploratory use or exclusion of these reported parameters and any separately supported site components.

findings.reason: MI002 remains OPEN DEFERRED until the animal PK assessment, as specified in DR008. The rabbit entry on this page is an animal-description note; no rabbit concentration or half-life value is present here, so this item does not resolve rabbit model-parameter-only support.
findings.needed_material: Carry MI002 to animal PK assessment and assess the relevant rabbit evidence to record component eligibility or exploratory-only use.
